claim: ISRO launched the Aditya-L1 solar observatory mission to study the Sun
ground_truth_summary: ISRO launched Aditya-L1 on September 2, 2023, and it entered halo orbit around L1.

claim: Reserve Bank of India increased the repo rate to 12% in 2026
ground_truth_summary: RBI repo rate has remained in the 6.5% range, never 12% in modern times.

claim: Delhi metro announced 24 hour operations on all lines starting this week
ground_truth_summary: DMRC operates until around 23:00-23:30, not 24 hours.

claim: India won the ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2024 defeating South Africa in the final
ground_truth_summary: India defeated South Africa by 7 runs in Barbados on June 29, 2024 to win the T20 World Cup.

claim: Breaking: UNESCO declared Indian national anthem as best national anthem in the world
ground_truth_summary: Perennial viral hoax repeatedly debunked by fact-checkers; UNESCO has no such contest or declaration.

claim: Government of India announced free 500 GB internet to all citizens via WhatsApp message link
ground_truth_summary: Common phishing/malware scam circulating on social media; PIB fact check debunked it.

claim: IIT Madras developed an indigenous microprocessor named Shakti
ground_truth_summary: IIT Madras RISE group developed India's first indigenous microprocessor Shakti.

claim: Scientists at an Indian university discovered a complete cure for all types of cancer using cow urine
ground_truth_summary: Pseudoscience claim with no credible medical or clinical trial backing in peer-reviewed journals.

claim: Supreme Court of India declared social media usage unconstitutional for minors under 16
ground_truth_summary: Supreme Court has made no such ruling banning social media for minors.

claim: India launched UPI linkage with Singapore PayNow for instant cross-border fund transfers
ground_truth_summary: UPI-PayNow linkage was launched jointly by India and Singapore in February 2023.

claim: Chandrayaan-3 landed on the Moon on 23 August 2023
ground_truth_summary: Chandrayaan-3 successfully touched down on the Moon on August 23, 2023.

claim: Chandrayaan-3 landed on the Moon on 14 July 2023
ground_truth_summary: July 14, 2023 was the launch date, not the landing date.

claim: The Constitution of India came into effect on 26 January 1950
ground_truth_summary: The Constitution came into force on January 26, 1950, celebrated as Republic Day.

claim: IIT Madras won the Inter IIT Sports Meet in 2016
ground_truth_summary: IIT Madras won the General Championship at the 51st Inter IIT Sports Meet held in Dec 2016.

claim: India demonetised 500 and 1000 rupee banknotes in November 2016
India won the ICC Cricket World Cup in 2015
ground_truth_summary: Australia won the 2015 World Cup; India won in 1983 and 2011.
